inputs.original_text: Workers employed in the support programmes of the Ministry of Education, Sport and Youth staged a protest outside the Presidential Palace on Thursday and announced a 24-hour strike, calling for legally binding job security guarantees — even as the government argued it had already delivered on the most significant demands. inputs.modified_text: Public service means putting the public first. A strike at the Presidential Palace that disrupts education and burdens families is no way to resolve workplace concerns—especially when the government says it has already met the most significant demands. Job security matters, but it does not erase workers’ duty to protect children’s schooling. Take the remaining issues to the negotiating table, not into a fight that makes families pay the price.
